NBO_EDGE_CLUSTER_PORTS: Test only: moves the cluster edge's three listeners (http, https, admin) off 80/443 so the black-box suite can run unprivileged.
NBO_EDGE_KUBE_API: Test only: points the edge's route-table reader at a fake Kubernetes API instead of kubernetes.default.svc.
NBO_EDGE_KUBE_TOKEN_FILE: Test only: service-account token path the edge reads; the in-cluster default is the only real value.
NBO_EDGE_KUBE_CA_FILE: Test only: CA file path for the fake Kubernetes API; the in-cluster default is the only real value.
NBO_EDGE_KUBE_POLL_MS: Test only: shortens how often the edge re-reads its route table so tests need not wait.
NBO_EDGE_HEADER_TIMEOUT_MS: Test only: lowers the wait for upstream response headers so timeout tests finish fast.
NBO_EDGE_RELAY_UPSTREAM_OVERRIDE: Test only: host:port that replaces the relay's upstream so tests need no cluster.
NBO_EDGE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS: Test only (Rust edge): shortens the idle limit on visitor connections.
NBO_ISRCACHE_URL: Set by NBO inside deployed apps (local nbo serve and deploys) to reach the page cache; never set by an operator.
NBO_PRERENDER_BYPASS: Set by NBO inside deployed apps: the revalidation secret the app checks; never set by an operator.
NBO_EDGE_RELAY_PORT: Test only: moves a relay's listener off 8443 so the black-box suite can run unprivileged.
NBO_EDGE_SOURCE: Set by NBO in the cluster edge's Deployment (kubernetes); never set by an operator.
NBO_EDGE_NAMESPACE: Set by NBO in the cluster edge's Deployment (the namespace holding its route table); never set by an operator.
NBO_EDGE_DRAIN_TOKEN: Set by NBO from a Kubernetes Secret on the cluster edge; the token for collecting Speed Insights. Never set by an operator.
NBO_EDGE_MODE: Set by NBO to relay on a private cluster's relay Deployment; never set by an operator.
NBO_RELAY_TOKEN: Set by NBO from a Kubernetes Secret on a relay; never set by an operator.
NBO_RELAY_TLS_CERT: Set by NBO on a relay: path of the mounted certificate; never set by an operator.
NBO_RELAY_TLS_KEY: Set by NBO on a relay: path of the mounted private key; never set by an operator.
NBO_CRON_SIGNING_SECRET: Set by NBO inside deployed apps so cron requests can be verified; never set by an operator.
NBO_ENV: Set by NBO for each build command (the environment's name); documented in the Environments chapter.
NBO_GIT_COMMIT_REF: Set by NBO for each build command (the branch); documented in the Environments chapter.
NBO_GIT_COMMIT_SHA: Set by NBO for each build command (the commit); documented in the Environments chapter.
NBO_GIT_PULL_REQUEST_ID: Set by NBO for a preview's build command (the pull request number, empty otherwise); documented in the Previews chapter.
NBO_PROTECTION: Set by NBO inside deployed apps of a protected environment: the hash of the deployment protection password; never set by an operator.
